exact_headers.name: NLA.SP15.parameter_box_bounds
exact_headers.header:
theorem parameter_box_bounds (x : Parameters) (hx : x ∈ parameterBox) :
    (∀ i : Fin 3, 0 < pCoordinates x i) ∧ 0 < x 6 ∧ 0 < x 7 ∧
    ∀ i : Fin 3,
      (∑ j ∈ Finset.univ.erase i, ‖qMatrix x i j‖) + 3 / 4 < (qMatrix x i i).re

exact_headers.name: NLA.SP15.p_intervals_separate
exact_headers.header:
theorem p_intervals_separate (x y : Parameters) (hx : x ∈ parameterBox)
    (hy : y ∈ parameterBox) (i j : Fin 3) (hij : i ≠ j) :
    pCoordinates x i ≠ pCoordinates y j

exact_headers.name: NLA.SP15.jacobian_lu_certificate
exact_headers.header:
theorem jacobian_lu_certificate :
    jacobianMinor = lowerCertificate * upperCertificate ∧
    (∀ i j : Fin 9, i < j → lowerCertificate i j = 0) ∧
    (∀ i : Fin 9, lowerCertificate i i = 1) ∧
    (∀ i j : Fin 9, j < i → upperCertificate i j = 0) ∧
    (∀ i : Fin 9, upperCertificate i i ≠ 0) ∧
    (∏ i : Fin 9, upperCertificate i i) = (-1088 : ℝ)
